description:
COSMOGEN ASTRA is a team of curious minds passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation. We aim to explore this year's NASA Space Apps challenges through creative thinking, research, and collaborative problem-solving.

We're looking for motivated teammates interested in programming, data analysis, scientific research, design, or storytelling. Beginners are welcome — curiosity, commitment, and teamwork matter most.
summary:
COSMOGEN ASTRA: SPACE MUSEUM

The Preservation of the Legacy of Space Exploration

COSMOGEN ASTRA: Space Museum is a self-developed research and education project created in response to NASA's Abandoned but Not Forgotten challenge. The aim of the project is to document, study, and preserve the scientific and historical value of man-made missions of space exploration and the technology left on other planets.

This project includes six outstanding milestones of space exploration: Surveyor 3, the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicles, Sojourner, Opportunity, Ingenuity, and Pioneer 10. The research focuses on the initial goals, technological innovations, significant achievements, and scientific value of the mentioned space equipment.

The project was developed in the form of a structured research table complemented with a seven-slide visual presentation that organizes information about NASA-related topics.

The documentation of historic space missions does not only include the history of space travel itself, but also the scientific information, technological innovations, and even a story behind these amazing machines. Even after they have completed their missions, these machines have much to contribute to future generations of researchers and space explorers.

The mission can be over. The legacy of it will always be remembered.
details: Project Overview COSMOGEN ASTRA: Space Museum is an independent digital research exhibition focusing on six important milestones in the history of space exploration: Surveyor 3, Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicles, Sojourner, Opportunity, Ingenuity, and Pioneer 10. Function & Approach The project includes a structured research spreadsheet and a seven-slide visual presentation, where the first one helps to organize all mission data, and the second allows to convey the importance of each subject. Benefits & Intended Impact The project will be helpful in preserving the legacy of space exploration and will help to raise the interest of students in space studies and history. Tools & Technologies Spreadsheet software, presentation software, NASA open source resources, and ChatGPT as well as Gemini to assist in conducting research, writing, and creating visuals. No coding or physical components were used during the project development process. Creativity & Considerations Being inspired by the idea of digital space museum, the project is based on well-organized research and consistent design featuring purple theme. Created by one author independently.
